title: Conditional Irrationality of All Projective Stabilizations of Cubic Threefolds: Point-Class Rank under Quantum Wall Crossing
description: Assuming the marked threshold compatibility hypothesis stated in this paper, X × P^m is irrational for every smooth complex cubic threefold X and every m ≥ 0. The endpoint contrast is unconditional: the paper reconstructs the primitive-sixth block from Cai's matrices, proves Gamma point-row nonvanishing by a Barnes calculation, and shows that multiplication by P^m produces m + 1 copies and preserves detection of the resulting packet while projective space has no primitive-sixth packet. It also proves an exact ambient point-column identity for a simple VGIT wall, exact Gamma point-row transport across an ordinary flop, global support collapse, a coefficientwise balanced Gamma-ratio reduction, and holonomicity with tempered growth for the complete neutral clutching tails. The remaining input is finite: each sign, stability, or zero-mode threshold connection matrix must fix the marked cyclic point row. A rational two-tail counterexample and the other countermodels explain why tailwise holonomicity, formal monodromy, pairing, integrality, and localized Fourier support do not replace that marked compatibility.
